descriptionChirho: A natural outflow of water from the ground; used both literally of physical springs and wells (John 4:6 Jacob's well/spring, Rev 8:10 springs of water, Rev 14:7 springs of waters) and figuratively of spiritual life-giving flow (John 4:14 spring of water welling up to eternal life, Rev 21:6 spring of the water of life) and of bodily discharge (Mark 5:29 flow of blood). Multilingual evidence is consistent: spa 'fuente/fuentes,' hin 'स्रोत/सोता/सोतों' (srot/sotā — source/spring), arb 'يَنْبُوع/يَنابيع' (yanbūʿ/yanābīʿ), kor '샘/샘들' (saem — spring), swa 'chemchemi/kisima' (spring/well). Singular S74703 and plural S74702 represent the same lexical meaning with grammatical number variation only.
